# Transparency Log Entry

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:TransparencyLogEntry`](gmeow-TransparencyLogEntry.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/TransparencyLogEntry>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/attestation`](../../slices/attestation.md)
- **Box roles:** [CBox role](../boxes/cbox.md), [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

An append-only registry evidence record such as a Rekor entry, SCITT receipt, certificate-transparency log entry, or timestamp/notary log entry. Proves inclusion at a point in time, not correctness ([Principle 1](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-1)).

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:InformationObject`](gmeow-InformationObject.md)

Use [`gmeow:TransparencyLogEntry`](gmeow-TransparencyLogEntry.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:InformationObject`](gmeow-InformationObject.md). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to record append-only-log evidence for an attestation — a Rekor entry, SCITT receipt, or certificate-transparency entry — when you need to capture that the attestation was logged at a point in time.

### Avoid when

- Avoid reading log inclusion as proof of correctness — a transparency log proves inclusion, NOT that the logged statement is true (module boundaries) — and avoid it for ledger/blockchain evidence (use [`gmeow:LedgerTransaction`](gmeow-LedgerTransaction.md) and friends).

### How to use

- Mint the entry with [`gmeow:logEntryIndex`](../properties/gmeow-logEntryIndex.md) (the EL minimum) and [`gmeow:logEntryUrl`](../properties/gmeow-logEntryUrl.md), link it from the [`Attestation`](gmeow-Attestation.md) with [`gmeow:transparencyLogEntry`](../properties/gmeow-transparencyLogEntry.md), and carry its inclusion proof on [`gmeow:ledgerInclusionProof`](../properties/gmeow-ledgerInclusionProof.md); the inclusion check itself runs in the solver layer.

### Examples

- ex:rekorEntry a [`gmeow:TransparencyLogEntry`](gmeow-TransparencyLogEntry.md); [`gmeow:logEntryIndex`](../properties/gmeow-logEntryIndex.md) 4815162342.
